compatibility_notes: Add the missing generic electronic_inductor_0603_4_7_micro_henry OOMP entry; no generic 4.7µH 0603 value/package entry exists. LCSC C1034 product page returned Part not found, so use the live JLC identity and its directly linked Sunlord SDFL-series datasheet.
evidence_notes: JLCPCB live detail page verified 2026-09-27: C1034; Sunlord; full MPN SDFL1608Q4R7KTF; 0603; badge Extended; 4.7uH; ±10%; Q 35 at 10MHz; self-resonant frequency 33MHz; 2.1Ω DCR; 15mA rated current.
The JLC page shows stock 85,480, minimum purchase quantity 1, full reel 4,000, available order quantity 72,726, SMT Assembly, and Economic and Standard PCBA types. No assembly minimum was displayed.
The LCSC product page https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C1034.html was opened in the browser and returned Part not found; it did not provide an identity cross-check or datasheet.

The PDF was downloaded by opening the actual datasheet link on the JLC product page. The six-page document is the Sunlord SDFL Series multilayer chip ferrite inductor datasheet. Page 1's ordering-code key defines 1608 as 0603, 4R7 as 4.7uH, K as ±10%, and shows the two-terminal chip form. Page 3's SDFL1608 table confirms 4.7uH, Q=35 at 10MHz, SRF=33MHz, DCR=2.1Ω, and rated current=15mA.
